name: Diff Viewer
description: A Dioxus component that shows the differences between two texts, split or inline, with word-level detail on changed lines.
background:
1. react-diff-viewer serves only React apps; Dioxus apps have no equivalent diff viewer.
2. Its diffing and styling rest on JavaScript libraries (jsdiff, emotion) with no Rust counterparts, so the port rebuilds both on Rust foundations.
expected_users: Dioxus apps that show changes between two versions of text or code.

title: What changed
purpose: Ensures readers can trust what the viewer marks as changed. Applied when reading or reviewing how changes are found and shown within lines, or when adding a way to compare text.
functional: Readers see at a glance which lines changed, and exactly which words changed within them.

title: Where they are
purpose: Ensures readers stay oriented in long diffs. Applied when reading or changing how unchanged lines fold and open, or how lines are numbered, highlighted, and selected.
functional: Readers keep their bearings: unchanged stretches fold out of the way, and every line has a number they can point to.

title: How it fits the app
purpose: Ensures the viewer can look native in any app. Applied when reviewing or changing themes, style overrides, or how an app draws line content and titles.
functional: Apps give the viewer their own look, light or dark, down to how each line's content is drawn.
